## Features

| Feature | What it does | ci | outside_ci |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message.ack_nack` | Ack and Nack are idempotent and exclude each other (message/message.go). | ✅ | — |
| `router` | The Router acks a message when its handler returns nil, nacks it on an error, and closes gracefully (message/router.go). | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.retry` | Retry retries a failing handler with backoff, then gives up. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.poison_queue` | PoisonQueue publishes an unprocessable message to a separate topic, and the chain continues. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.recoverer` | Recoverer turns a panic in a handler into an error. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.timeout` | Timeout cancels the message context after a deadline. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.throttle` | Throttle limits how many messages a handler processes per unit of time. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.circuit_breaker` | CircuitBreaker fails fast when a handler keeps returning errors. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.deduplicator` | Deduplicator drops a message it has already processed within a time window. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.instant_ack` | InstantAck acks a message as soon as it arrives, regardless of errors. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.correlation` | CorrelationID propagates a correlation ID from a consumed message to the messages it produces. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.ignore_errors` | IgnoreErrors treats listed errors as success. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.delay_on_error` | DelayOnError sets delay metadata on a message whose handler failed. | ✅ | — |
| `middleware.duplicator` | Duplicator processes each message twice, to check that a handler is idempotent. | ✅ | — |
| `component.cqrs` | CQRS command and event buses route commands and events to handlers. | ✅ | — |
| `component.forwarder` | Forwarder publishes messages stored in one Pub/Sub (an outbox) to another. | ✅ | — |
| `component.requeuer` | Requeuer moves messages from one topic back to another, for example from a poison queue. | ✅ | — |
| `component.delay` | The delay component publishes and consumes delayed messages. | ✅ | — |
| `component.fanin` | FanIn merges several topics into one. | ✅ | — |
| `component.requestreply` | Request-reply sends a command and waits for its reply. | ✅ | — |
| `component.metrics` | Metrics exposes Prometheus metrics for the Router and Pub/Subs. | ✅ | — |

- `ack.ack_cancels_message_context` — Ack or Nack cancels the message's context (Subscriber interface).
- `ack.broker_ack_after_watermill_ack` — The ack or offset reaches the broker only after the Watermill message is acked (docs: must).
- `ack.nack_redelivers` — A nacked message is redelivered (Subscriber interface).
- `ack.next_only_after_ack` — The next message is delivered only after the current one is acked (Subscriber interface).
- `ack.unacked_redelivered_after_timeout` — A message that is never acked or nacked is redelivered after the backend's ack timeout.

- `shutdown.concurrent_close_safe` — Closing subscribers concurrently while they consume is safe.
- `shutdown.inflight_ack_reaches_broker` — The ack of a message in flight during shutdown reaches the broker before shutdown completes.
- `shutdown.publisher_close_flushes` — Publisher Close flushes unsent messages.
- `shutdown.router_waits_for_inflight` — Router Close waits for in-flight handlers, up to CloseTimeout, on this Pub/Sub.
- `shutdown.subscribe_ctx_cancel_closes` — Canceling the Subscribe context closes the subscription and its channel.
- `shutdown.subscriber_close_keeps_offsets` — After a subscriber closes, a new subscriber continues where it stopped (Close flushes offsets).

## Lattices

### `pubsub.features`

Every capability a Pub/Sub declares in tests.Features (pubsub/tests/test_pubsub.go). A Pub/Sub claims a capability when any of its test configurations sets the flag, and must pass the test for it. A Pub/Sub that declares a capability false answers it as unsupported, with no proof yet.
